notes.title: 1.2.3 Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
Minor Changes:


Levels:

Fixed a bug where the game did not zoom in as intended at level start.



Settings:

Fixed a crash that occurs when opening the settings menu.

notes.title: 1.2.2 Demo Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes:

Dialogue:

 Added new curator dialogue in A1.
 Added new Neb dialogue in A3 or A6, depending on the order of completion.


Marker:

 Introduced a new triangle marker option.
 Slightly reworded marker tooltips for clarity.


Levels:

 All levels now display a difficulty rating.


Settings:

 Added input binding options for triangle markers.


Minor Changes and Bug Fixes:

Audio:

 Fixed a bug where dialogue speech sound effects ignored audio settings.


Profile:

 Fixed misalignment of profile slots when selecting the profile copy option.


Sprites:

 Tweaked the glass sprite for improved visibility.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Minor Changes:
	
Levels:

 Fixed misaligned markers placed by hints on level T3.
 Fixed broken hints for levels S1 and S2.

notes.title: 1.2.0 Demo Ambience Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes:

Audio:

Introduced a completely new original soundtrack and sound effects composed by RyanAVX.


Profile:

Updated the game logo to a new design.


Tower:

 Moved the side walls closer to the tower, creating a more claustrophobic atmosphere.


Sprites:

 Overhauled the game's palette to resemble an SNES-style palette.
 Tweaked some sprites for better visibility.
 Adjusted layering of sprites to improve clarity.


Dialogue:

 Updated dialogue colors to match the new palette.


Levels:

 Recentered all rooms for better positioning.
 S1 and S2 now zoom in at the start of the room.
 Victory text on room completion no longer remains permanently.
 Adjusted completion percentage based on current bonus rooms (Exact room count is unknown and subject to change, hence the ?).


Credits:

 Removed audio credits for tracks and SFX that were replaced.
 Added composer credits for Ryan Allen (RyanAVX).


Minor Changes and Bug Fixes:

Audio:

 Fixed a bug where re-entering a room before the audio fully transitioned would cause the wrong track to play.


Levels:

 Fixed a bug where there was no flash effect during room completion.
 Fixed an issue where a portion of a challenge room appeared blurry.
 S-room labels no longer display a leading 0, as they now count up in hexadecimal.


Dialogue:

 Clicking the menu while dialogue is playing no longer allows dialogue inputs.


Markers:

 Clicking on a GUI element no longer places a marker.


Other:

 Slightly increased ghost visibility.
 Fixed a bug where profile saves sometimes failed to record minutes and seconds.
 Fixed an issue where the zoom start speed was incorrectly applied during the first zoom-in press if zoom was not triggered at the start of the game.
 Fixed a bug where zooming in on room select via input button would switch focus to a previous room.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Demo Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes:

Zoom:

 Players can now zoom in on individual rooms.
 Zoom functionality added for tower view.
 Rooms now automatically zoom in upon loading.


Marker:

 Markers now support an undo feature, allowing players to revert all previous marker changes.


Replay:

 Replay mode now includes a zoom feature.
 Added marker undo functionality to Replay.


Dialogue:

 All character portraits are now more expressive.
 Before meeting Grace, the ??? Ghost portrait now has a bowtie.
 Added dialogue guiding players to the history tracker markers.
 A new GUI window now appears during mid-game dialogue (if notifications are enabled) allowing to still modify markers before dialogue.
 Increased spacing in the dialogue window between the border and the name field.
 Curator dialogue has been slightly reduced and rephrased during T1, T2, and T3 at the move limit.
 Significantly modified the Curator’s dialogue upon entering the S room.
 Updated the dialogue for Neb when multiple undos are used, now with a Deja Vu reference.
 Revised the introduction of the undo/reset mechanic and marker mechanic.
 Revised the introduction of the marker tool mechanic telling about inputs.


Hints:

 Simplified the hint dialogue when clicking for the first time.
 Adjusted hint phrasing and hints for various levels:

 T1: Hint 1 now points to the exit and rephrased some lines.
 T3, A1, A5, A6, B5, B6: Reduced or modified hints and rephrased some lines.
 A2, A3, A4, B2, B3: Reduced the number of hints.
 A7, A8, B1: Updated hint phrasing.
 B1: Hint 1 now points to the glass.



Settings:

 Added a notification setting to the gameplay tab.
 Added zoom in on start and zoom in on start speed setting to the gameplay tab
 Added zoom shortcut within the input tab.
 Added shortcuts for drawer undo and redo within the input tab.
 Added additional shortcut for exiting the replay.


Sprites:

 Improved Curator, Neb, and Grace dialogue portraits to prevent compression artifacts.


Credits:

 Added credits for the old phone sound effect.
 Added a thank you message for players.


Other:

 Fixed a major bug causing slight blurriness in sprites.


Minor Changes and Bug Fixes:

Dialogue:

 Dialogue triggers now activate at the end of the turn instead of immediately, fixing an issue where the Curator could introduce itself mid-replay in T1 & T2.
 Fixed dialogue shake effect during Curator introduction.


Audio:

 Adjusted sound effects:

 Button click volume reduced and pitch increased.
 Wrong button click volume and pitch reduced.
 Teleportation sound volume slightly reduced and glitch removed at the end.



Markers:

 Fixed a bug where clearing arrow markers and drawing new ones connected new arrows with previously erased ones.
 Swapped marker eraser toggles. Full erase now selected by default.


Levels:

 Adjusted room positions:

 T Zone: Raised rooms T2 by 1 tile, T3 by 1 tile.
 A Zone: Raised rooms A1 by 1 tile, A2 by 1 tiles, A3 by 1 tile, A4 by 2 tiles, A5 by 2 tiles, A6 by 1 tile, A7 by 1 tile, and A8 by 2 tiles.
 B Zone: Raised rooms B2 by 1 tile, B3 by 1 tile, B5 by 3 tiles, and B6 by 2 tile.



Settings:

 Updated tooltips for "Wait" and "Reset."
 Hide borderless toggle when in fullscreen.


Other:

 Fixed offline teleporter sprite.
 Removed "..." special character from font.
 Shake effect duration is now dependent on scroll speed as set in the settings.
 Mouse inputs now display a shortened version (e.g., "LMB" instead of "Left Mouse Button").

notes.title: Demo 1.0.2 Bugfix and small parity changes
notes.notes:
Major Changes:

Levels:

 Inverted room T1 to increase the likelihood of the player hitting a wall.
 Added bonus "Not in Demo" levels for A and B zones to maintain parity.
 Adjusted the completion percentage based on currently available bonus rooms. (Exact number of rooms is unknown and subject to change, hence the "?".)


Dialogue:

 Added 2 additional lines of dialogue for the T1 Ghost referencing the teleporter to reduce player confusion.


Minor Changes and Bug Fixes:

Level Select:

 Clicking outside any level nodes no longer causes the focus to be lost.
 During dialogue, level nodes now lose focus and regain it after dialogue ends.
 Returning from the escape menu will automatically focus on a level node.
 Fixed a minor tiling mistake on the tower.


Replay:

 Fixed tooltip display on the replay history button.
 Resolved a bug where the ghost would move up during a reset.


Dialogue:

 Fixed an issue where pressing "Next" during dialogue on the level select screen would incorrectly launch the level.
 Fixed a bug where pressing "Draw" as dialogue ended would activate it.
 Fixed a bug where pressing "Wait" as dialogue ended would activate it.
 Fixed an issue where ghosts weren’t blinking during their dialogue sequences.
 Dialogue now disables the "Wait" button from being pressed via shortcuts.
 Dialogue now disables the "Undo" button from being pressed via shortcuts.
 Dialogue now disables the "Hint" button from being pressed via shortcuts.


Achievements:

 Added an additional "Not in Demo" achievement for parity.
 Fixed the achievement tooltip in the menu, now showing the correct information instead of a settings tooltip.
 Updated achievement requirements:
 Area A completion changed from 9 to 12.
 Area B completion changed from 9 to 10.


Settings:

 Updated the tooltip for action speed in the animation settings.
 Updated the tooltip for undo action speed in the animation settings.
 Removed the "Skip Dialogue" option from settings.
 Added an "Effects" toggle in the settings for improved performance on older computers and laptops.


Profile:

 When erasing and copying over a profile slot, the correct completion percentage is now displayed.


Other:

 Updated the "%" character in the font, along with other minor font changes.

notes.notes: Fixed a minor issue where achievements were displaying as completed incorrectly.
